input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "PUB006",
  "title": "Aeration Blower Delayed Start",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# Aeration Blower Delayed Start\n\n- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)\n\n## Requirements\n\nControl a wastewater-treatment aeration blower with a low-dissolved-oxygen demand, a 5-second start delay, emergency-stop priority and start-cycle counting.\n\n1. Start delay timing when both DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC are TRUE. Allow BLOWER_RUN to become TRUE only after these conditions have remained satisfied for 5 seconds.\n2. If DO_LOW becomes FALSE or an emergency stop occurs, immediately disable BLOWER_RUN and reset the start timer, whether timing is incomplete or complete. A new demand must wait the full 5 seconds again.\n3. Increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT once on each FALSE-to-TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN. Do not count repeatedly during continuous operation.\n4. At power-up, initialize the blower to OFF and the start count to zero. The start delay gates a BOOL enable; no continuous speed ramp is required.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `DO_LOW` | `BOOL` | Dissolved oxygen is below its threshold and aeration is needed. |\n| Input | `AERATION_E_STOP_NC` | `BOOL` | TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active. |\n| Output | `BLOWER_RUN` | `BOOL` | Blower motor-contactor run command. |\n| Output | `AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT` | `UINT` | Count of actual blower starts. |",
  "scenario": "Control a wastewater-treatment aeration blower with a low-dissolved-oxygen demand, a 5-second start delay, emergency-stop priority and start-cycle counting.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "DO_LOW",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Dissolved oxygen is below its threshold and aeration is needed."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "AERATION_E_STOP_NC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "BLOWER_RUN",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Blower motor-contactor run command."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT",
      "type": "UINT",
      "description": "Count of actual blower starts."
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "BLOWER_RUN": false,
    "AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT": 0,
    "delayElapsed_ms": 0
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "DO_LOW FALSE or emergency stop overrides timing and resets it immediately."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Start delay elapsed is zero at the first sample of DO_LOW & AERATION_E_STOP_NC; run becomes TRUE at elapsed>=5s.",
    "Count increments on the same invocation that changes end-of-scan BLOWER_RUN from FALSE to TRUE.",
    "Tests stay below UINT overflow; overflow behavior is outside the specified operating domain.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P1",
      "formula": "G(BLOWER_RUN <-> (permit & delayDone))",
      "explanation": "Run is enabled only after the full delay.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P2",
      "formula": "G(!permit -> (!BLOWER_RUN & X(!delayDone)))",
      "explanation": "Loss of demand or safety permissive clears run and its timer.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P3",
      "formula": "G((!runPrev & BLOWER_RUN) -> AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT=countPrev+1)",
      "explanation": "One count per genuine start.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P4",
      "formula": "G((runPrev | !BLOWER_RUN) -> AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT=countPrev)",
      "explanation": "No repeated count during continuous operation or stop.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB006.P5",
      "formula": "(G(F(TimeTick))) -> (G((G(permit)) -> F(BLOWER_RUN)))",
      "explanation": "A sustained permitted demand eventually starts under advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "permit": "DO_LOW & AERATION_E_STOP_NC",
    "delayDone": "Permissive has continuously remained true for >=5s after its first sampled TRUE.",
    "runPrev": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].BLOWER_RUN\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].BLOWER_RUN; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "countPrev": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT\", \"initial\": 0, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "interface names": "Identically named sampled input or observed output.",
    "TimeTick": "Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.",
    "DO_LOW": "I[k].DO_LOW: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "AERATION_E_STOP_NC": "I[k].AERATION_E_STOP_NC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "BLOWER_RUN": "O[k].BLOWER_RUN: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT": "O[k].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT: independently observed post-scan candidate value (UINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.BLOWER_RUN=false, O_init.AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT=0."
  }
}
